let value: number | string = 1;
const result = (value ??= 'fallback');
value += 'x';
console.log(value, result);
let explicit: number | string | undefined = 1;
if (explicit !== undefined) explicit ??= 'a';
explicit += 'b';
console.log(explicit);
let changing: number | string = 1;
changing ??= 'a';
changing ??= 'b';
changing += 'c';
console.log(changing);
class CoalescingAccessor {
  private stored = 1;
  get value(): number { return this.stored; }
  set value(value: number | string) { this.stored = typeof value === 'number' ? value : value.length; }
}
function useAccessor(obj: CoalescingAccessor) {
  obj.value ??= 'a';
  obj.value += 'b';
  return obj.value;
}
console.log(useAccessor(new CoalescingAccessor()));
